title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Renewal Experience Modifier
content:
### Renewal experience modifier — Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs, residential renewal schedule

On the Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount tier, the program renewal rate per 100 is multiplied by a modifier worked out from the program's own claim experience.

**36 months or more in force.** The modifier is 1 plus one half (0.5) of the amount by which the program's 36-month renewal loss ratio exceeds 0.40 (a ratio below 0.40 lowers it), kept no lower than 0.85 and no higher than 1.25. That ratio is the claim payments issued under the program's certificates in the last 36 months less the claim payments voided in those 36 months, divided by the lender payments the program received in those 36 months, and it is zero when no lender payment was received in that window.

**At least 12 but fewer than 36 months.** The modifier is 1.10 when any claim payment was issued under the program's certificates in the last 12 months and 0.97 when none was.

**Fewer than 12 months.** The modifier is 1.00.

**Counting.** Months in force for a renewal are the whole calendar months from the program effective date to today, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached, and a renewal window of the last N months covers every entry dated on a day from which fewer than N such whole months have passed by today.

### Input – judgement – output (hypothetical)

| Program in force | Claim experience | Modifier |
|---|---|---|
| 48 months | ratio 0.60 | 1.10 |
| 48 months | ratio 0.30 | 0.95 |
| 48 months | ratio 2.00 | 1.25 |
| 24 months | a claim payment issued 5 months ago | 1.10 |
| 24 months | no claim payment in the last 12 months | 0.97 |
| 8 months | any | 1.00 |
